name: 4,5-MDO-DMT
summary: 4,5-MDO-DMT, or 4,5-methylenedioxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a lesser-known psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family. It is the 4,5-methylenedioxy derivative of dimethyltryptamine (DMT) and is an analogue of psilocin (4-HO-DMT) and 5-MeO-DMT.
summaryZh: 4,5-MDO-DMT是一種色胺衍生物，化學式為C13H16N2O2，由亞歷山大·舒爾金開發，屬於N,N-二甲基色胺的衍生物，其致幻能力弱於4,5-MDO-DiPT，強於5,6-MDO-DiPT。
summaryZhHans: 4,5-MDO-DMT是一种色胺衍生物，化学式为C13H16N2O2，由亚历山大·舒尔金开发，属于N,N-二甲基色胺的衍生物，其致幻能力弱于4,5-MDO-DiPT，强于5,6-MDO-DiPT。
